name: Takahashi Katsune
source:
A super shy zombie girl.

She has a miraculous singing voice, but cannot express herself in public.
She is timid, but she is the most kind and considerate of people above all others.

After becoming a zombie, the blood flowing through her somehow turned into vintage wine, and when she gets excited, her blood flow increases to the point that she automatically gets drunk, making her a difficult girl to deal with.

[translated from [url=http://www.akabeesoft3.com/products/hakata_dz/index.html]official website[/url]]
